_comment_servers: Container hostnames in compose. Order matters: server-1 plays the role of simulation device 0 (the source), server-2 = device 1, server-3 = device 2.
_comment_D_tt: Link bandwidths. D_tt[0] = server-1 <-> server-2, D_tt[1] = server-2 <-> server-3, D_tt[2] = server-1 <-> server-3.
_comment_D_BER: Per-link BER values, same ordering as D_tt.
